$comment: DRAFT 2027 weekly departure patterns for owner review (prepared 16 Oct 2026). NOT read by `npm run departures` (it reads only tools/departure-schedules.json), so nothing here is on the site or bookable. Patterns, times and return rules are copied unchanged from the 2026 schedule and trip data; no business fact is added. Report: `node tools/schedule-draft-report.mjs` writes docs/schedule-2027-draft.md. To apply once HCC confirms: extend the matching entry's `to` in tools/departure-schedules.json (or add an entry for a route not yet there) and run `npm run departures`. Never add a second entry for the same trip + origin: the generator deletes that route's files outside each entry's own range, so two entries would delete each other's dates.
